observations.content: User provided context-only preparation packets 1/12 through 9/12 for a later explicit implementation task and repeatedly instructed not to implement yet; assistant acknowledged each with CONTEXT_RECEIVED.

Historical implementation requirements: expose actual pi usage cost from every observer/consolidator worker run, including ephemeral and unsuccessful runs when usage is valid; persist valid costs as session-ledger entries with role/run identity; aggregate costs across all branches including abandoned branches; ignore missing, malformed, non-finite, or negative costs; surface totals in status/footer; add focused tests for aggregation, invalid entries, handoff, and display.
